en.pageTitle: "Golden Vow" Candace Is Here! Participate in the Event to Win Merchandise
en.name: "Golden Vow" Candace Is Here! Participate in the Event to Win Merchandise
en.description: Olah! Hello, Travelers~ Aaru Village lies on the edge of the desert. Though it is cut off by the Wall of Samiel, it is still a safe place that welcomes those who wish for rest. As the Guardian of Aaru Village, Candace's job is to keep the village safe. People have differing views on Candace. While The Eremites regard her as a true descendant of King Deshret, with the terrifying power to control the desert, young adventurers who have been to the desert have found her warm and kind... But Candace cares little for others' opinions of her. In Candace's case, anyone can rest and seek help in Aaru Village so long as they abide by the rules. If anyone breaks those rules and intends to do harm, Candace will not hesitate to take care of them personally. Candace has made protecting Aaru Village her top priority. So, dear Traveler, what is it that you hold dear, that you want to protect the most? (*╹▽╹*)

en.description: Olah! Hello, Travelers~ As adventurers of Teyvat, you have often had to face various challenges and trials! Did you have an exciting experience in the "Adventurer's Trials" event? If you could design the challenge trials, what ideas would you come up with? Come share it all with us! Share your ideas for a chance to win Primogems!

pageTitle: "Fantastical Evening Star" Layla (Cryo) Is Here! Participate in the Event to Win Merchandise~

en.pageTitle: "Fantastical Evening Star" Layla (Cryo) Is Here! Participate in the Event to Win Merchandise~
en.name: "Fantastical Evening Star" Layla (Cryo) Is Here! Participate in the Event to Win Merchandise~
en.description: Olah! Hello, Travelers~ Today, we will be introducing Layla, a student from the Rtawahist Darshan! The Rtawahist Darshan of the six Darshans under the Sumeru Akademiya is dedicated to the study of Illuminationism. Layla can be found among the researchers of Illuminationism, which is centered around astrology and astronomy, learning of the cosmos that has clutched the world in its embrace since time immemorial. Layla draws star charts tirelessly in order to write her thesis. Due to her teachers' high expectations, her desk is always stacked with a mountain of papers that never seems to decrease no matter how hard she tries. Layla's academic career has put her under a lot of pressure. Do you have any relaxation tips to share with her?

en.description: Olah! Hello, Travelers~ Today, we will be introducing Faruzan, a household name in Haravatat! There is a legend circulating among the Kshahrewar students: if you have failed your mechanics exams and do not dare ask for remedial lessons from your displeased tutor, you can make your way to Haravatat next door and ask "the living encyclopedia of mechanics" Madam Faruzan for some tips. Faruzan has significant knowledge of ancient scripts and machines of all kinds. Are there areas that particularly interest you? Come and share them with Faruzan!

en.description: Olah! Hello, Travelers~ Today, we will be introducing a disciple of Streetward Rambler - Yaoyao! In the eyes of the people of Liyue Harbor, Madame Ping always brings the smiley Yaoyao along with her, and the two behave like a loving grandparent with her grandchild. In truth, Yaoyao is Madame Ping's — or should we say Streetward Rambler's — disciple. Yaoyao is a warmhearted and considerate child, and the adepti are all very fond of her. Although she is still very young, she will in time become a most knowledgeable girl. Traveler, do you have topics that you want to discuss with Yaoyao?

en.description: Olah! Hello, Travelers~ Today, we will be introducing Mika, the Front-Line Land Surveyor of the Knights of Favonius. As a member of the Knights of Favonius Reconnaissance Company, Mika always diligently fulfills all the duties that come his way. Setting up tents, lighting fires for cooking, repairing equipment... Even Hertha, the logistics captain, has nothing but praise for Mika's excellent efficiency. What a reliable Front-Line Land Surveyor Mika is! Becoming a member of Knights of Favonius Reconnaissance Company must open the door to lot of amazing adventures! Traveler, if you have a chance to go on adventures with the Knights of Favonius Reconnaissance Company, which unknown area would you choose to explore? Remember to record the details of landscape data with Mika!

en.description: Olah! Hello, Travelers~ Today, we will be introducing Kaveh, a renowned architect from Sumeru. Titles, rumors, fame, and reputation... These are all mere by-products of his work. Equipped with astounding professional design skills, Kaveh puts his heart and soul into his work and is imbued with ideals and pursuits for aesthetics and architectonics. For him, designs that are completely divorced from reality should be classified as fantasy, whereas a building that is actually put into construction must have practical value. As expected of this outstanding Kshahrewar graduate, Kaveh! If you had the opportunity to study at the Akademiya, what specialized knowledge would you want to acquire? Would you choose to become an architect like Kaveh?

en.name: "Cat Upon the Eaves" Kirara Is Here! Participate in the Event to Win Merchandise~
en.description: Olah! Hello, Travelers~ The companion we're about to introduce today is Kirara — Gold Level Courier of the Komaniya Express. Komaniya Express, the famous delivery company in Inazuma, has a very special employee working under them. At a glance, she resembles an adorably-dressed teenage girl with two tails swaying behind her. Though she treats each of her customers with kindness and generosity, she sometimes secretly takes to running quietly across rooftops to ensure none of her deliveries arrive late... Who else but the dedicated Kirara could be so commonly complimented as being "safe and punctual," "service assured," "vivacious and adorable" on the feedback board! It appears that as long as you have something you love doing, then you'll be filled with enthusiasm for everything around you. ヾ(≧▽≦*)o We trust that our Travelers must also have things they're passionate about too. Come share them with me in the comments! o(￣▽￣)o~

pageTitle: An Easy-Breezy Natlan in an Easy-Breezy Summer!

en.pageTitle: An Easy-Breezy Natlan in an Easy-Breezy Summer!
en.name: An Easy-Breezy Natlan in an Easy-Breezy Summer!
en.description: After the long battle, the Speaker's Chamber decided to build a grand resort for the summer, to comfort those who had been scorched by the years of fire and war. The resort's location was ultimately chosen by vote: A stunning, sparsely inhabited island off the westernmost edge of Natlan: Tenochtzitoc. This choice was not just made for the scenery, but also because the war had begun there. It was only right for it to come full circle and meet its end in Tenochtzitoc as well.

en.name: An Elegy for Faded Moonlight
en.description: The howling coyotes seek the moon's fading trail, while shadows hang heavy upon every heart. Ancient memories resurface before our eyes, and the riddles left by history still drive countless souls to struggle onward in the torrent of fate.

en.name: Artful Odyssey
en.description: The Miliastra Wonderland is officially open! Gather your friends and team up for an exciting new adventure in Artful Odyssey! Complete event missions to obtain "Geodes of Replication," Manekin action, Primogems, Amazon Gift Cards, and other rewards!

en.name: Alcyon Chapter
en.description: "Go, child of the fae." "Make your way to the villages and towns and seek kinship with the humans..." "The world of the fae is rife with a sorrow you do not understand." Once upon a time, a young Linnea caught the faint, lilting refrains of a strange little tune. Many years later, the echoes of that song have finally found her once again.

en.name: As All Falls to Emptiness
en.description: People describe wisdom in many different ways: an eternal garden, an imperishable monument, an ancient tree that reaches the sky. And from these they extract what they most desire: a flower, a stone, a leaf... Wisdom also seeps into every dream, for better or for worse, flowing like a stream, projecting itself as the shadow of a tree over every corner of the world. Thus, the catastrophe that lurks in dreams manifests itself... Now, it is descending.

en.name: Curtain of Leaves - Spiral Abyss Challenge
en.description: The Forest Ranger from Sumeru, Collei, seems to be in a bit of a pickle... Somewhere deep in the rainforest, a reckless researcher from the Akademiya has activated a secretly-developed machine to break into a huge, spiraling set of ruins. Though her skills and her survival techniques should allow her to escape on her own, her master and friends are worried for her safety nonetheless. So please, would you take a quick gander in there to search for her?

en.name: Draco Rubedo Chapter
en.description: Fairy tales often end on a good note... Blessings will be offered, and curses will be broken. Make a sincere wish, and it will come true. Wield your sword with courage, and every foe shall fall. In the end, "they lived happily ever after." But then what? Some readers can't help but ask. As a character born from the pages of a story, Durin sometimes finds himself facing that very question. His story seems to have reached a happy ending in Simulanka, yet he never knows where to start when trying to explain what happened afterward. If only he had his mother's magical touch with words, perhaps then he could turn those experiences into another enchanting story of his own...

pageTitle: Of Fading Flowers and Falling Feathers (Event)

en.pageTitle: Of Fading Flowers and Falling Feathers (Event)
en.name: Of Fading Flowers and Falling Feathers
en.description: Winds stirred by Saurian wings, and warriors soaring through the heavens. Since ancient times, successive generations of the Flower-Feather Clan's elite have watched over their tribe, patrolling the skies with their Qucusaurus companions. Yet beneath this radiant sheen of glorious victory, shadows of loss and failure loom. Some Saurians are born with wings, just as some people come into this world endowed with innate talent. Others, however, can do naught else but spend their lives gazing up from the ground... Over time, such obsession builds, until eventually it piles up into towering ambition. But will this ever be enough to take them up to that distant, unattainable firmament?

en.name: Stellar Reunion
en.description: Event Rules During the event, returning Travelers can participate and complete objectives in "Reunion Locales" and "Homeward Path" to claim the corresponding rewards. During the event, you will also receive the "Reunion Blessing" and enjoy bonus drops, alongside chances to open Hangout Events without using up Story Keys. "Reunion Locales" Exploration Rewards During the event, go to the areas recommended by "Reunion Locales," explore, and complete the designated challenges to claim the corresponding rewards. "Homeward Path" Quest Rewards Complete the recommended Archon Quests during the event to claim additional rewards. "Current Wish" Level-Up Rewards Complete the designated level-up goals during the event to claim the corresponding rewards. Miliastra Wonderland Play Rewards Complete the designated gameplay objectives during the event to claim the corresponding rewards. "Passage of Time" Login Rewards Log in every day to claim rewards (refreshes daily at 4:00 AM //). Only one login reward can be claimed each day for up to 7 days. "Reunion Blessing" Temporary Domain Opening During Stellar Reunion, some Domains will not be limited by their usual time restrictions and will remain open. After Stellar Reunion ends, these Domains will go back to their normal schedule, so challenge them while they are available. "Reunion Blessing" Double Drop Bonus Returning Travelers receive 21 opportunities across the event period to gain double drops, and up to 3 may be used by Returning Travelers each day. These can be used to obtain double the rewards from Petrified Trees in Domains of Blessing, Forgery, and Mastery, or from Ley Line Blossoms of Revelation and Wealth, using Original Resin. The amount of double drop opportunities refreshes daily at 4:00 AM (//). Be sure to use these opportunities in time! "Returning Companions" Key-Free Hangouts You may unlock up to 3 Hangout Events for free during this time. Unlocking said Hangout Events will consume uses of "Returning Companions" instead of Story Keys as long as you have uses remaining, so be sure to make use of this opportunity.|Event Guidelines

en.description: Olah! Hello, Travelers~ "The Recollector's Path" event has already begun, has everyone already encountered the Pari Sorush? During this event, Travelers will help Sorush pass through multiple trials, understand the role of a Pari "Bloomguard," and become a worthy Bloomguard! It sounds like another adventure filled with meaning and excitement! However, it won't be easy to pass through the trials. How can every single uninvited guest be expelled with limited Nirodha Fruit? Just where exactly are the important locations in our recollections? I don't get it either... and just what are the responsibilities of a Bloomguard? Do you have the answers? From now until May 22, share your tips and tricks for "The Recollector's Path" or your understanding of a Bloomguard's role for a chance to win Primogem prizes!

en.name: Tapirus Somniator Chapter
en.description: According to Inazuman folklore, as the day wanes and eyelids grow heavy, a chubby little creature may visit those blessed by fortune. Should this happen, you'd best set aside whatever it is you're doing and go to sleep immediately, for this cute critter is a baku — a youkai who feeds on nightmares. The current inhabitants of Inazuma, however, need not be particularly well-blessed to rid themselves of unpleasant dreams. All they need do is book an appointment at the Aisa Bathhouse in Inazuma City. Rumor has it that each of the bathhouse's therapists is a baku in the guise of a young woman, and that they have helped many a nightmare-plagued patient find release from their troubles. Nevertheless, the once-flourishing Aisa Bathhouse appears to be facing a financial crisis. To understand why, you must first rest your weary head and seek an encounter in the realm of dreams...

en.description: Olah! Hello, Travelers~ Have you ever ran into trouble during your travels? For example, you don't know where to start when faced with a difficult puzzle? Or you don't know how to build a character? Or that time when you discovered a great party composition strategy and didn't know who to share it with? To help you navigate the land of Teyvat more smoothly, I have decided to establish the "Hilichurl Support Group"! Whether you're a budding new Traveler who doesn't know where to start, or an avid Traveler who is willing to share your gaming experiences, you can join a team to help one another. I have also prepared exquisite merchandise rewards for Travelers who participate actively~

en.name: Where the Springs Return
en.description: Since the People of the Springs was first established, an ancient legend has circulated within the tribe — a mysterious island, situated in a rarely visited Domain, promises astonishing wealth and unparalleled glory to those who reach it. Yet, however tempting it might sound, this bounty is far from easily attained. In all their history, only a handful have ever managed to reach this island. It is said that even the top guides from the People of the Springs are unable to guarantee passage through all the trials that must first be passed. But naturally, for someone whose adventures have already taken them across five nations, the opportunity to take up such a challenge is too good to simply pass up. Yet, before you can embark on this journey, it seems that there is a "condition that must be met"...
